checklist.title: After reinstalling Windows
checklist.description: Mark each step as you complete it. Your checklist is saved on this computer.
checklist.saveError: The checklist could not be saved.
items: Activate Windows and confirm the installed edition matches your license.
Install Windows updates and restart when prompted.
Install drivers from Windows Update or your computer manufacturer's website.
Install the essential apps you use every day.
Update Windows Security and run a scan.
Create a restore point before changing system settings.
Back up documents to another drive or cloud storage.
Prepare recovery media on an empty USB drive.
Check internet, audio, Bluetooth, printer, and Device Manager.
